explanation.headline: FDA's records show daptomycin is not on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include daptomycin as of 2026-10-21.

Both Corvale East and Corvale General are supplied from the same NDC 71288001791 labeled by Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. with the manufacturing plant named on the label as Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co.
Corvale East has 114 vials on hand at 14.5 vials per day, providing 7.9 days of supply.
Corvale General has 278 vials on hand at 15.2 vials per day, providing 18.3 days of supply.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 64 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave Corvale General with 14 days and bring Corvale East to 12 days of supply.
Alternate manufacturers APOTEX CORP. and Accord Healthcare Inc. are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
